source_title: Frederick Anderson Collection to Host Cocktail Kick-off Party for UBCF ahead of 25th Anniversary Think Pink Gala
source_excerpt:
NEW YORK , Oct. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- United Breast Cancer Foundation (UBCF) is excited to announce an exclusive cocktail reception hosted by Frederick Anderson Collection in celebration of the foundation's upcoming Think Pink Gala at The Plaza. The evening will bring together fashion, philanthropy, and breast cancer advocacy in support of UBCF's mission to provide financial and emotional assistance to individuals impacted by breast cancer.
Generously hosted by Frederick Anderson Collection , the cocktail reception will welcome an exclusive list of invitees for an evening celebrating the power of community, generosity, and the collective commitment to making a difference in the lives of breast cancer patients and survivors.
"We are incredibly excited to partner with Frederick Anderson for an evening that brings together fashion and philanthropy" said Stephanie Mastroianni, president and executive director of UBCF. "A huge thank you to Frederick and esteemed honoree Sabine Poisson for putting together this lovely kick off party, that will serve as a teaser for the festivities to come."
Opportunities like this allow UBCF to expand their reach, build meaningful relationships, and introduce more people to the work the do every day. Behind every program they offer is a real person or family whose lives are impacted by breast cancer. Real people who UBCF ensures never have to feel like they have to face that journey alone."
The cocktail party will take place this coming Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at the Frederick Anderson Collection studio as a special kickoff to UBCF's highly anticipated Think Pink Gala. The Gala is set to take place at The Plaza hotel on November 20th, and, with the recently announced closing of the Plaza, will prove to be one of the last galas to take place for the foreseeable future in the iconic NYC hotel.
The Think Pink Gala will be chaired by Abigail Spencer and Lauren E. Walsh and will recognize distinguished guests and advocates Denyce Graves-Montgomery, Sabine Poisson, Nevin Djoganopoulos, and Kiley Durham for their contributions and support to the breast cancer community.
To learn more about the Think Pink Gala, or to purchase tables, tickets, or to make a donation please visit thinkpinkgala.org .
Through its programs and services, UBCF provides essential financial and emotional care to breast cancer patients and survivors, helping ease the burdens that often accompany a diagnosis. From financial assistance and holistic care to free shopping events and essential resources, UBCF remains committed to ensuring that no one faces breast cancer alone.
The partnership with Frederick Anderson Collection reflects the importance of bringing together individuals and organizations who believe in the power of philanthropy, awareness, and meaningful action.
United Breast Cancer Foundation (UBCF) is a national 501(c)(3) nonprofit that began as a small grassroots organization serving low-income, under and non-insured women and men in New York State. UBCF is headquartered in Jonesboro, AR and has regional offices in New York. We serve women, men and their families across the country.
